descriptions.zh: 我们在气态巨行星[From.GetName]的轨道上发现了一些大型生物的残骸。我们的科学家希望分析它们以推断它们的起源。
descriptions.en: We have found the dead remains of several large creatures in orbit around the gas giant [From.GetName]. Our scientists would like to study them more closely to determine their origins.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]冰幔下隐藏着大海。科学家希望可以组织一次深海探险以研究此处的特殊生命形态。
descriptions.en: There is a large ocean hidden beneath the ice mantle of [From.GetName]. Our scientists would like to mount an expedition to study the unique life forms of this environment.

descriptions.zh: 一具发现于[From.GetName]了无生机的地表上的巨型骸骨，其历史可追溯到三百万年前。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]迫切希望可以解开谜团。
descriptions.en: A gigantic skeleton dating back more than three billion years has been found on the lifeless surface of [From.GetName]. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are eager to get to the bottom of this mystery.

descriptions.zh: 我们于[From.GetName]的地表偶然发现了一处星舰坟场，似乎是数千年前低轨道的一次宏大战争的遗留。回收这些古老残骸的科学考察已经正式提上了日程。
descriptions.en: We have stumbled upon a starship graveyard on the surface of [From.GetName], the result of a titanic battle that occurred in close orbit thousands of years ago. A scientific expedition to study these ancient hulks and see if anything can be salvaged has been proposed.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]数千年前被未知的力量进行了未完全的环境改造。如今设备仍可在[From.GetPlanetMoon]上找到，我们的科学家正设法重启这些设备。
descriptions.en: [From.GetName] was partially terraformed thousands of years ago by an unknown agency. The terraforming equipment can still be found on the [From.GetPlanetMoon], and our scientists are looking for a way to resume the process.

descriptions.zh: 尽管年岁已长，[From.GetName]上的环境改造设备还是显得很先进的。我们的工程师请求允许拆解并研究它们，看看我们能从建造它的科技中学到些什么。
descriptions.en: Despite its age, the abandoned terraforming equipment on [From.GetName] appears to be quite advanced. Some of our engineers have asked for permission to dismantle and analyze the equipment, to see what can be learned from its technology.

descriptions.zh: 一只变异的生物正威胁着我们在[From.GetName]上的殖民地居民，已经有很多人死去，殖民地居民请求我们帮助他们找到并消灭这生物。
descriptions.en: A mutated creature is terrorizing the population of our colony on [From.GetName]. Many have died and the colonists are asking for help in their efforts to hunt down and eliminate the creature.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]上发现了一幅写满外星文字的远古壁画。只要投入人力物力，我们应该可以翻译这些内容。
descriptions.en: An ancient mural covered in alien letters has been found on [From.GetName]. With dedicated resources, we should be able to translate the writing.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的殖民者无意中启动了一枚废弃的氢弹。我们需要在其计时结束前解除它！
descriptions.en: An abandoned hydrogen bomb has been inadvertently activated by our colonists on [From.GetName]. We need to disarm it before the timer runs out!

descriptions.zh: 我们的一部分科学家希望通过对这些外星植被进行后续研究进而找到一种不用破坏森林就能解决问题的办法。
descriptions.en: Several of our scientists are hoping that a solution which doesn't involve the destruction of the forests can be found by continued studies of this alien flora.

descriptions.zh: 我们不能容忍这些森林的存在，我们必须将其从[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的表面清理掉。
descriptions.en: The presence of these forests cannot be tolerated. An effort must be made to cleanse them from the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface.

descriptions.zh: 我们应该试着与[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人建立联络。或许我们能找到与他们文明的共存之道。
descriptions.en: We need to find some way to communicate with the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens. Perhaps we can find a way to coexist with their civilization.

descriptions.zh: 地下外星人正在挖掘通往地表的道路，这是一个威胁，我们必须立刻处理。我们要先发制人，攻击他们的地下都市。
descriptions.en: The aliens digging their way to the surface are a threat that must be dealt with. We will launch a preemptive strike against their underground cities.

descriptions.zh: [From.From.GetName]的地下外星文明对我们的殖民地是个威胁，我们必须要消灭他们，设法攻击他们的地下都市。
descriptions.en: The subterranean alien civilization on [From.From.GetName] is a clear threat to our colony and must be destroyed. We need to find a way to strike at their cities underground.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]发现了一个巨大的地下宝库。科学家们正在尽力寻找打开加固门的办法以便了解宝库里到底有什么。
descriptions.en: We have discovered a large underground vault on [From.GetName]. Our scientists are looking for a way to open the vault's reinforced doors so that we may learn what is inside.

descriptions.zh: 环绕[Root.GetName]周围的轨道空间中充满了杂乱无章的碎片，严重影响到了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上殖民地的发展，扫描并绘制碎片区域地图需要科技船上装载的强大传感器。
descriptions.en: The orbital space around [Root.GetName] is cluttered with debris that is interfering with the development of the colony on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Mapping the extensive debris field will require the powerful sensors of a Science Ship.

descriptions.zh: 一个老旧的自动化船坞的残骸被发现在[From.GetName]的轨道上。工程师认为他们可以让其中一个保存完好的制造港恢复电力。
descriptions.en: The remains of an old automated shipyard have been found orbiting [From.GetName]. Our engineers believe that they can restore power to the shipyard's sole surviving manufacturing bay.

descriptions.zh: 一艘废弃的飞船被发现于气态巨行星[From.GetName]的大气层深处。一些科学家和工程师提出了一个计划，将其升至高层大气并回收。
descriptions.en: A derelict ship has been found deep within the atmosphere of the gas giant [From.GetName]. Some of our scientists and engineers have proposed a project to raise the vessel to the upper atmosphere and salvage it.

descriptions.zh: 环绕[From.GetName]的卫星之一将会撞击这个气态巨行星的表面。这个极为罕见的奇景将会被记载下来流传后世。
descriptions.en: One of the moons circling [From.GetName] will soon impact the surface of the gas giant. This extremely rare event should be recorded for posterity.

descriptions.zh: 我们从气态巨行星[From.GetName]的内部收到了一个微弱的信号。这可能是某种通讯，但我们尚未将信号分离出来。
descriptions.en: We have picked up a weak signal coming from the interior of the gas giant [From.GetName]. It may be a transmission of some kind, but we have not yet been able to isolate the signal.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经同意将达斯纳克人从它们即将要毁灭的母星转移至气态巨行星[baldarak_planet.GetName]。在那里它们将会建立新的家园。时间紧迫。
descriptions.en: We have agreed to transport the Dathnak from their doomed homeworld to the gas giant [baldarak_planet.GetName], where they will make a new home. Time is short.

descriptions.zh: 达斯纳克想在[NewBaldarak.GetName]这一气态巨行星上建立一个新的殖民地，那里的大气层很适合他们生存。我们已同意帮助他们。
descriptions.en: The Dathnak would like to found a new colony on [NewBaldarak.GetName], a gas giant with an atmosphere suitable to their physiology. We have agreed to assist them in this endeavor.

descriptions.zh: 在伯达拉克的达斯纳克政府与他们在新伯达拉克的殖民地失去了联系，他们担心出现最坏的结果。我们已经同意调查这个星球。
descriptions.en: The Dathnak authorities on Baldarak have lost contact with their colony on New Baldarak, and they fear the worst. We have agreed to investigate the planet.

descriptions.zh: 在新伯达拉克的达斯纳克革命者希望我们能够帮助运送他们的突击部队到达伯达拉克，这样他们能够在当地煽动起义。
descriptions.en: The Dathnak revolutionaries on New Baldarak have asked us to transport one of their commando units to Baldarak, where they will try to incite some kind of revolt.

descriptions.zh: 达斯纳克政府决心恢复对被叛军占领的新伯达拉克地区的控制权。我们已经同意运输他们的远征军前往那里。
descriptions.en: The Dathnak government on Baldarak is determined to restore control over their rebelling colony on New Baldarak. We have agreed to transport an expeditionary force to the planet.

descriptions.zh: 达斯纳克殖民者查比克·莱迪思念自己的家乡，希望能够回到伯达拉克。我们勉强答应了这个要求。
descriptions.en: The Dathnak colonist Chabky Raddh is apparently homesick and wishes to return to Baldarak. We have reluctantly agreed to arrange this.

descriptions.zh: 我们的一架穿梭机被[pre_ftl_country.GetName]的原住民击落，我们必须在幸存者被当地军队俘虏之前把他们全数救出。
descriptions.en: One of our shuttles was shot down by the natives on [pre_ftl_country.GetName], and we need to rescue any surviving operatives before they are captured by local forces.

descriptions.zh: 我们的一名科学家已经叛逃，在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上被当地[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]当做神灵来崇拜。必须采取行动将[missing_scientist.GetHimHer]移除——有必要的话可以采取武力。
descriptions.en: One of our scientists has gone rogue and is being worshiped as a god by the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. An operation must be launched to remove [missing_scientist.GetHimHer] - by force if necessary.

descriptions.zh: 我们的科学家想要从[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的土著文明中寻找实验对象收集数据。测试完毕后，目标对象将会被抹除记忆，送回[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]地表。
descriptions.en: Our scientists would like to gather test subjects from the native civilization on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. After the tests have been conducted, the subjects will be returned to the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface with no memory of the experience.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]的火山口从前是一个古老的沃陶姆采矿基地。在其附近会建立一个考古挖掘地来寻找遗迹里有用的东西。
descriptions.en: A crater on [From.GetName] was once the site of an ancient Vultaum mining base. An archaeological dig site will be established nearby to search the ruins for anything useful.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]之前有一个沃陶姆天文台，一个远离他们古老帝国的[From.GetPlanetMoon]。考古学家对分析研究这个天文台遗址充满兴趣。
descriptions.en: There was once a Vultaum observatory on [From.GetName], a [From.GetPlanetMoon] that lies quite some distance away from their ancient empire. Archeologists are eager to study the abandoned ruins.

descriptions.zh: 有一座属于沃陶姆的已经崩毁了的太空电梯依然环绕在[From.GetName]的赤道轨道上。显然这里藏有大量的文物，在[From.GetPlanetMoon]的表面建立一作考察站一定是明智之举。
descriptions.en: A collapsed Vultaum space elevator can be found near the equator on [From.GetName]. There are surely many artifacts to be found if an archaeological dig site is established on the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface.

descriptions.zh: 一座位于[From.GetName]的陨石坑集群里的大都会遗址曾是一座沃陶姆的主要都市。派遣考察队来这里挖掘显然是非常有必要的。
descriptions.en: A collection of large craters on [From.GetName] was once a major Vultaum metropolis. An archaeological dig site is needed to excavate potential artifacts.

descriptions.zh: 在[From.GetName]上的沃陶姆核心殖民地崩溃前，此处曾是一个巨大的隧道网络。派遣考察队来这里挖掘显然是非常有必要的。
descriptions.en: There was once a vast tunnel network on [From.GetName] that housed a major Vultaum colony before its collapse. An archaeological dig site is needed to excavate the ruins.

descriptions.zh: 沃陶姆气体开采站的一部分仍然环绕着[From.GetName]。种种迹象标明这里曾经遭受过劫掠，但我们的考古专家坚信这里仍然还留有重要物品有待发现。
descriptions.en: The partial remains of a Vultaum gas mining station still orbit [From.GetName]. The derelict facility has been looted before, but our archaeologists are confident there are still discoveries to be made.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]上曾一度有一个沃陶姆贸易站。挖掘出遗迹需要很大工夫，但考古学家认为这是值得的。
descriptions.en: A Vultaum trade post could once be found on [From.GetName]. The abandoned ruins need to be properly excavated, but our archaeologists assure us it would be worth the effort.

descriptions.zh: 一颗古老的沃陶姆人造卫星正在[From.GetName]的引力轨道上磕磕绊绊地公转着。其发射阵列已被打捞回收，我们的数据工程师正如饥似渴地分析着设备。
descriptions.en: An ancient Vultaum satellite was stumbled upon in orbit of [From.GetName]. Its transmitter array has been salvaged, and our data engineers are anxious to analyze the equipment.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了一片位于[From.GetName]上的沃陶姆分裂者殖民地。一旦我们的考察开始进行，我们就可以发现很多有价值的文物。
descriptions.en: We have discovered what appears to be the ruins of a Vultaum splinter colony on [From.GetName]. Once a dig site has been set up, our archaeologists can begin excavating the ruins for valuable artifacts.

descriptions.zh: 一副空荡荡的轨道复合体的金属框架漂浮在[From.GetName]的外空间区域。其建成目的似乎是有关虚拟现实研究，但是如果我们要了解更多相关信息的话，就需要进行一次适当的考古调查。
descriptions.en: The metal skeleton of a massive Vultaum orbital complex has been found above [From.GetName]. Its purpose seems to have been virtual reality research, but a proper archaeological survey needs to be conducted if we are to learn more.

descriptions.zh: 这个位于[From.GetName]小行星上的矿物采掘基地如今就只剩下一个巨大的陨石坑了。然而初步地质扫描显示，他们的一些采矿坑道可能完好地保存在地表之下。
descriptions.en: A massive crater is all that remains of an ancient Vultaum mining base on asteroid [From.GetName]. Preliminary scans suggest that some of their mining tunnels may have survived, however.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经定位了沃陶姆母恒星系的坐标。
descriptions.en: We now have the coordinates of the Vultaum home system.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]已经被确定为一颗曾作为尤特的孵化场的行星，它们的幼崽被遗留在这里，任其自然成长。一次考察行动必然会让我们获得很多有价值的化石。
descriptions.en: [From.GetName] has been identified as a former Yuht hatchery world, where their infants were left to slowly mature on their own. An archaeological dig on this world is certain to produce valuable fossils.

descriptions.zh: 尤特百万年前在这里建造了大量巨大的监听阵列。虽然早已失效，但附近的考古挖掘还是会有大发现的。
descriptions.en: Several massive listening arrays were built on this world by the Yuht millions of years ago. Though they have long since stopped working, an archaeological excavation of the surrounding area could produce significant findings.

descriptions.zh: 一座主题为“外星骗局”的尤特博物馆遗址被发现在[From.GetName]的地表上。它曾展出过数十种被认为是外星的文物，我们的考古专家对其所剩的那些文物仍然充满兴趣。
descriptions.en: An ancient Yuht museum dedicated to "alien frauds" was discovered on [From.GetName]. It once exhibited dozens of supposedly alien artifacts, and our archaeologists would like to study the few that still remain.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]曾是一片繁荣的尤特殖民地，而且我们已经确认看似是巨型墓场的地方实际上是[From.GetPlanetMoon]的一块独立的区域。显然针对这一地点开展一次考古挖掘行动是有价值的。
descriptions.en: [From.GetName] was once home to a thriving Yuht colony, and we have identified what appears to be a massive graveyard in an isolated region of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]. It may be worth the effort to establish an archaeological excavation site there.

descriptions.zh: 数百万年前，[From.GetName]上曾爆发了一场尤特与其他种族之间的毁灭性地面战争。我们的考古学家很乐意去搜索古战场，以发掘有价值的文物。
descriptions.en: Millions of years ago, [From.GetName] was the scene of a devastating ground campaign between the Yuht and another species. Our archaeologists would like to scour the ancient battlefields for valuable artifacts.

descriptions.zh: 尤特在[From.GetName]的轨道上，放置了一颗卫星，以纪念与外星智慧生物的首次接触。一队考古学家申请资金对它进行全面分析。
descriptions.en: The Yuht placed a satellite in orbit of [From.GetName] to commemorate the first time they encountered another sapient alien species. A team of archaeologists have requested resources to conduct a full analysis of it.

descriptions.zh: 一艘尤特巡洋舰经历战斗后，被遗弃在[From.GetName]的轨道上。我们的考古学家想登船分析这艘古船。
descriptions.en: A derelict Yuht cruiser was apparently abandoned in orbit of [From.GetName] after a battle. Our archaeologists would like to board and analyze what remains of this ancient vessel.

descriptions.zh: 在[From.GetName]的轨道上，发现了尤特殖民船的残骸。如由一队科学家对其进行探索，会有不错的发现。
descriptions.en: The wreckage of what appears to be a Yuht colony ship was discovered in orbit of [From.GetName]. An analysis of the vessel by a team of archaeologists could yield interesting findings.

descriptions.zh: 小行星[From.GetName]上似乎有古代尤特居所的遗迹。组织一支远征队，派往调查小行星的洞窟，获取更多情报。
descriptions.en: Asteroid [From.GetName] appears to house the remains of an ancient Yuht dwelling. An away team must be organized and sent to investigate the asteroid's caverns to learn more about it.

descriptions.zh: 尤特的古老母星的坐标已最终定位。
descriptions.en: The ancient homeworld of the Yuht has finally been located.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]上方有第一联盟舰队基地的遗迹。有些残骸似乎足够稳定到可以支持我们进行考古作业。
descriptions.en: The remnants of a First League naval base have been located above [From.GetName]. Some of the debris appears stable enough to support an archaeological mission.

descriptions.zh: 我们侦测到了一块属于第一联合巡洋舰的舰艏残骸正在环绕着[From.GetName]进行公转。一支登舰团队将研究其上的残余物以让我们了解其更多。
descriptions.en: We have detected what appears to be the bow section of an old First League cruiser orbiting [From.GetName]. A boarding party will need to study the remains if we are to learn more.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]应该是已消灭的汉姆达的母星，该种群是古老第一联盟的创始成员之一。[From.GetPlanetMoon]深陷于废墟之间，等待发掘。
descriptions.en: [From.GetName] appears to be the homeworld of the extinct Khamdai, one of the founding members of the ancient First League. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] is covered in ruins ready to be excavated.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现[From.GetName]是绝迹的卡萨克的母星，该种群是古老第一联盟的创始成员之一。在[From.GetPlanetMoon]的表面上，仍可以看到地下城市的废墟。
descriptions.en: We have identified [From.GetName] as the ancient homeworld of the serpentine Chassago, one of the founding members of the First League. There are still ruins from their subterranean cities to be found on the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface.

descriptions.zh: 百万年前，米格杨是第一联盟的创始成员之一，我们认为[From.GetName]是他们的母星。这么多年过去了，他们高耸入云的遗迹仍旧矗立。
descriptions.en: Two million years ago, the Migir-Yan were among the founding members of the First League, and we believe [From.GetName] was their homeworld. Even after all these years, a few of their towering arcologies are still standing.

descriptions.zh: 古老的维若帕是第一联盟的创始成员之一，有证据显示[From.GetName]曾经是他们的母星。这些鸟类挖空了山脉，建造了巨大的城市，我们考古学家有兴趣探索调查他们的废墟。
descriptions.en: The ancient V'ropak were founding members of the First League, and evidence suggests that [From.GetName] was their homeworld. These avians built great cities within hollowed out mesas, and our archaeologists would like permission to investigate their ruins.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]的表面能看到大地面装置的废墟。我们认为这里曾经是古老的第一联盟建立的研究基地，但要靠近调查才能确定。
descriptions.en: The ruins of a large ground installation can be found on the surface of [From.GetName]. We believe these buildings were part of a major research base built by the ancient First League, but the ruins need to be studied more closely to be certain.

descriptions.zh: 第一联盟将殖民地建立在了[From.GetName]的五湖四海上，这里曾到处都是各其成员物种。殖民地看起来像是衰落了，但我们必须挖掘废墟以确定它消逝的原因。
descriptions.en: The First League established a colony on [From.GetName] at some point, populating it with settlers from all of its member species. It would seem the colony failed, but we will have to excavate the ruins to determine why.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]曾经是古老的第一联盟主要的贸易中心。[From.GetPlanetMoon]曾经高度城市化，现在还留下了许多废墟供考古学家研究。
descriptions.en: [From.GetName] was once a major center of trade in the ancient First League. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] was heavily urbanized, and there are still plenty of ruins left for our archaeologists to study.

descriptions.zh: 两百万年前，第一联盟一场大型飞船战斗在[From.GetName]附近爆发。飞往[From.GetPlanetMoon]的航道上，还能看到这些飞船的残骸，我们的考古学家建议在附近建立营地。
descriptions.en: A massive fleet battle involving the First League occurred two million years ago near [From.GetName]. Some of the wreckage found its way to the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface, and our archaeologists suggest the establishment of a base camp nearby.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]气候恶劣，是古代的第一联盟的罪犯流放地，这里危机四伏，但要是建立考古发掘场的话，应该可以发掘出一些监狱设施。
descriptions.en: The hostile [From.GetPlanetMoon] of [From.GetName] served as a penal colony in the ancient First League, and some of the prison facilities could be excavated if we establish an archaeological dig site.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]是某个尚处于青铜时代初期的文明的母星，该文明处在第一联盟的观测下。已发现数处有价值的考古挖掘场。
descriptions.en: [From.GetName] was the homeworld of an early Bronze Age civilization that appears to have been under observation by the First League. Several promising dig sites have already been identified.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]是某个未知物种的母星，这个物种似乎受到第一联盟飞船的轨道封锁。派出考古队有望发掘更多信息。
descriptions.en: [From.GetName] was the homeworld of an unidentified species that seems to have been the subject of an orbital blockade by ships from the First League. An archaeological mission will hopefully reveal more.

descriptions.zh: 小行星[From.GetName]显然曾经是走私犯、海盗和第一联盟内其他罪犯的藏身之处。我们应该对这颗小行星的内部进行彻查，以期发现可能存在的来自第一联合的文物。
descriptions.en: Asteroid [From.GetName] was apparently used as hidden port by smugglers, pirates and other criminal elements within the First League. We should comb through the interior of this asteroid for First League artifacts.

descriptions.zh: 哈本尼斯之泽恒星系是远古第一联盟的行政中心和经济中心。
descriptions.en: The Fen Habbanis system was the political, administrative and economical center of the ancient First League.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]上伊拉斯人的殖民地因贾沃疹而毁灭，但有证据表明这事情发生前[From.GetPlanetMoon]曾受到封锁。我们需要更深入地检查轨道碎片，以获取更多信息。
descriptions.en: The Irassian colony on [From.GetName] fell to the Javorian Pox, but there is evidence that the [From.GetPlanetMoon] was subjected to a blockade just before this happened. To learn more, we will have to examine the orbital debris more closely.

descriptions.zh: 一百二十万年前，[From.GetName]遭受到一次猛烈的轨道轰炸，在此之前[From.GetPlanetMoon]曾是伊拉斯人的一个繁荣的殖民地。也许一次考古调查可以了解更多情况。
descriptions.en: [From.GetName] was subjected to massive orbital bombardment 1.2 million years ago, but before that the [From.GetPlanetMoon] was a flourishing Irassian colony. Perhaps an archaeological expedition can learn more.

descriptions.zh: 软体类物种丘格拉起源于[From.GetName]，它是一个被伊拉斯协约国所征服的物种。我们对其知之甚少，不过没准一次考古调查便可以弥补这点。
descriptions.en: The molluscoid Joggra originated on [From.GetName], a subjugated client species of the Irassian Concordat. Little is known of them, but perhaps an archaeological expedition can remedy this.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]是提德格的远古母星，但一百二十万年前，它遭受了一次全面的轨道轰炸。我们知道提德格是伊拉斯人的几个附庸物种之一，但究竟是什么原因促成了这次轰炸依旧是个谜。
descriptions.en: [From.GetName] was the ancient homeworld of the Ti'Derg, but it suffered a comprehensive orbital bombardment 1.2 million years ago. It is known that the Ti'Derg were one of several Irassian client species, but exactly what prompted this bombardment remains a mystery.

descriptions.zh: 在[From.GetName]上伊拉斯人的殖民地遗迹里只剩下化石与废墟。它看起来像是成为了贾沃疹的另一个受害者，但也许一次考古调查可以让我们对这个殖民地的命运有更多的了解。
descriptions.en: Only ruins and fossils remain of the Irassian colony on [From.GetName]. It appears to have been another victim of the Javorian Pox, but perhaps an archaeological mission can shed some more light on the colony's fate.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]上深深的矿洞表明，这里曾经是伊拉斯人的采矿基地。我们的考古学家想要深入调查。
descriptions.en: The deep boreholes on [From.GetName] indicate the former presence of an Irassian mining base. Our archaeologists would like to investigate them further.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]曾是一个很早就受到贾沃疹打击的受害地，我们的考古学家想研究伊拉斯人的殖民地以发现蛛丝马迹，从而追踪瘟疫的病原。
descriptions.en: [From.GetName] was an early victim of the Javorian Pox, and our archaeologists would like to study the former Irassian colony for clues as to the origin of the disease.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的轨道上发现了一艘废弃的伊拉斯巡洋舰。一队考古学家已经整装待发。
descriptions.en: We have encountered a derelict Irassian cruiser orbiting [From.GetName]. A team of archaeologists stand ready to board the vessel.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]上发现了伊拉斯人的轨道空间站碎片，这里应该是他们疾病控制权威部门的总部，若想获得更多信息，需要对废墟进行广泛搜寻。
descriptions.en: The shattered remains of an Irassian orbital station was found above [From.GetName]. It appears to have served as the headquarters of their Disease Control authority, but to learn more we will need to conduct an extensive search of the debris field.

descriptions.zh: 小行星[From.GetName]上发现了被遗弃的军用监听哨站。我们认为这是古老的伊拉斯协约国设立的。
descriptions.en: An abandoned military listening post has been found on asteroid [From.GetName]. We believe it may have been constructed by the ancient Irassian Concordat.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]周围轨道上发现了一座古老的伊拉斯人的研究站遗址。看上去伊拉斯出于某种原因一直在研究这个气态巨行星。
descriptions.en: Orbital debris from an ancient Irassian research station has been found above [From.GetName]. The Irassians appear to have been studying the gas giant for some reason.

descriptions.zh: 伊拉斯星系是古老的伊拉斯协约国的核心。
descriptions.en: The Irass system was the heart of the ancient Irassian Concordat.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]曾经是克尔的母星，同样受到了残暴的赛博勒克斯的攻击。克尔文明就只残留下少数几个废墟，它们依旧有研究价值。
descriptions.en: [From.GetName], the former Kuur homeworld, is yet another victim of the rampaging Cybrex. A few crumbling ruins are all that remains of the Kuur civilization, but they should be investigated.

descriptions.zh: 在名为赛博勒克斯的机械意识将其战体降临于此并毁灭一切之前，[From.GetName]是古老的因迪马克文明的母星。这里或许会有重大的考古发现。
descriptions.en: [From.GetName] was once the homeworld of the ancient Indimak civilization, before the warforms of the Cybrex machine consciousness descended upon it leaving only destruction in their wake. There may be important archaeological findings here.

titles.zh: 受损的赛博勒克斯战体

descriptions.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近轨道上发现了两个赛博勒克斯的战体残骸。需要深入调查。
descriptions.en: Two ruined Cybrex warforms have been found in orbit around [From.GetName]. They should be investigated more closely.

descriptions.zh: 很久以前[From.GetName]发生过一场大规模的地面战争，当时赛博勒克斯正在攻击[From.GetPlanetMoon]的原住民。现在依旧可能在这古战场找到当年的文物。
descriptions.en: A ground war of massive proportions took place on [From.GetName] long ago, when the Cybrex invaded the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s original owners. This ancient battlefield should be searched for artifacts.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]是被赛博勒克斯高度开发的星球，但在赤道附近有一片矩形的未被开发过的区域。我们的科学家必须搞清楚原因。
descriptions.en: [From.GetName] was heavily developed by the Cybrex, but for unclear reasons they left a large rectangular area near the equator mostly untouched. Our archaeologists should investigate why.

descriptions.zh: 小行星[From.GetName]实际上并非一个小行星，而是赛博勒克斯的人造航天器。大约在60万年前，赛博勒克斯把它用作一处监听哨站。
descriptions.en: Asteroid [From.GetName] is actually not an asteroid, but an artificially constructed object made by the Cybrex. It served them as a concealed listening post roughly 600,000 years ago.

descriptions.zh: 在[From.GetName]周围的轨道上漂浮着一些来自赛博勒克斯精炼厂的碎片。看起来这些机器曾经在这里进行过某种形式的采矿作业。
descriptions.en: Debris from a large Cybrex refinery complex floats in orbit over [From.GetName]. It seems like the machines were engaged in some kind of mining operation here.

descriptions.zh: 大约60万年前在[From.GetName]附近爆发过一场大规模的太空会战，至少五支舰队参与其中。其中一支属于赛博勒克斯。
descriptions.en: A space battle of truly colossal proportions took place near [From.GetName] 600,000 years ago with ships from at least five different fleets involved. One of these fleets belonged to the Cybrex.

descriptions.zh: 以前在[From.GetName]的表面有一个属于赛博勒克斯的基地，但现在这里仅剩一个弹坑。我们应该调查清楚到底发生了什么。
descriptions.en: There was once a large Cybrex base on the surface of [From.GetName], until it was reduced to a crater. We should investigate what happened.

descriptions.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近轨道发现了大约一千具外星人尸体。他们死亡时间与赛博勒克斯控制这部分星系的时间大致相符。
descriptions.en: The corpses from almost a thousand aliens have been found in orbit above [From.GetName]. They appear to have died around the same time as the Cybrex controlled this portion of the galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近轨道发现的赛博勒克斯研究站其中一个工作模块中包含了一些赛博勒克斯族的残留物。
descriptions.en: A module from a Cybrex research station was found orbiting [From.GetName] containing the remnants of some kind of cybernetic creatures.

descriptions.zh: 赛博勒克斯最后似乎撤离到了这个星系。
descriptions.en: The Cybrex seem to have retreated to this star system.

descriptions.zh: 在海洋星球[This.GetName]的海面下发现了塔布拉克。
descriptions.en: Tarblacs are found deep beneath the waves on the ocean world [This.GetName].

descriptions.zh: [This.GetName]潮湿的丛林中出现过塔萨古德的身影。
descriptions.en: Tassargoids have been sighted in the humid jungles of [This.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 欧林提在[This.GetName]各地大规模存在。
descriptions.en: Orinthi have been reported in large numbers across most of [This.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 萨尼兰只存在于[This.GetName]的沙海中。
descriptions.en: Snirans are unique to the great dune seas of [This.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 古兰萨兽群可能只存在于[This.GetName]的开阔草原上。
descriptions.en: Goolantha herds may only be found on the open steppes of [This.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 乌杜兰的踪迹只出现在[This.GetName]被雪覆盖的荒地上。
descriptions.en: Uddlorans can be found racing through the snowy wastes of [This.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 祖卡虫群是[This.GetName]干燥峡谷的原住民。
descriptions.en: Zulcor swarms are native to the dry canyons of [This.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 在[space_probe.GetStarName]星系中，我们发现了我们老旧的亚光速探测器。一定要尽快回收。
descriptions.en: We have sighted one of our old sublight space probes in the [space_probe.GetStarName] system. It must be recovered as soon as possible.

descriptions.zh: 一条邪教徒的舰船被我们的武装力量所瘫痪。我们应该登船以确保我们能够找到有价值的情报和人员。
descriptions.en: One of the cultist ships has been disabled by our forces. We should conduct a boarding operation to secure prisoners and any intelligence assets we find.

descriptions.zh: 我们瘫痪掉了邪教徒的旗舰！若想成功登陆并俘获舰船，必须派出大量部队。
descriptions.en: We have disabled the cultist flagship! A substantial number of troops will be needed to successfully board and capture the vessel.

descriptions.zh: 这群邪教徒看来发展出了某种新武器，追踪他们基地的行动到这里就中止了。如果我们调查他们的科技，我们或许可以发现邪教徒领袖的下落。
descriptions.en: The cult has been developing some new type of weapon, and the trace to their base of operations have ended here. If we investigate their technology we might find some clues to their leader's whereabouts.

descriptions.zh: 走私贩们在[From.GetName]地表设立了一个非法哨站，这是一个受到我们保护的土著庇护所星球。必须在他们的行为对[From.GetPlanetMoon]的本土文明造成更大的危害前消除掉这个隐患。
descriptions.en: Smugglers have established an illegal outpost on the surface of [From.GetName], a primitive sanctuary world under our protection. They must be removed before they cause lasting harm to the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s native civilization.

descriptions.zh: 我们终于追踪到叛徒是在[From.GetName]上城市郊区的一处藏身之所。我们有必要下令舰队从太空中对这个地点进行轰炸。
descriptions.en: Our rogue covert infiltration operative on [From.GetName] has finally been tracked to a safe house in the suburbs of a large city. We need fleet assets in orbit to bombard his position from space.

descriptions.zh: 由于我们在[prelude_to_war_planet.GetName]上的秘密行动出现了意外，[prelude_to_war_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经到达了核战爆发的边缘。我们在[prelude_to_war_planet.GetPlanetMoon]上的渗透单位要求一艘在轨的科研船平息这一局面。
descriptions.en: Due to an incident related to our covert infiltration program on [prelude_to_war_planet.GetName], the [prelude_to_war_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been brought to the brink of nuclear war. Our infiltration cells on the [prelude_to_war_planet.GetPlanetMoon] require a Science Ship in orbit to calm the situation.

descriptions.zh: 不知道为什么，有人将[shielded_planet.GetName]包裹在了一个无法被穿透的能量屏障中。屏障的能量层级在不断波动，说明它已经被启用数千年了。我们必须找到解除这个屏障的方法，然后发掘其背后的秘密。
descriptions.en: For reasons unknown, someone or something has encased [shielded_planet.GetName] in an impenetrable energy shield. Its energy levels are fluctuating, suggesting that the shield has been active for many thousands of years. We must find some way to nullify the barrier and discover what lies beneath!

descriptions.zh:
我们需要进一步了解我们将其编码命名为§Y[Prev.From.GetName]§!的神秘外星种群。如果他们也拥有语言，那我们必须对其进行破译并且建立交流。

奖励：£influence£ §G影响力§!或§S特殊项目§!
descriptions.en:
We need to learn more about the mysterious aliens we have code-named §Y[Prev.From.GetName]§!. If they possess a language, we must decipher it and establish communications.

Reward: £influence£ §GInfluence§! or §SSpecial Project§!

descriptions.zh: 风信子号位于[hyacinth_planet.GetName]，从结构上看没有遭受损伤。我们需要集结一支登陆部队来确认在这艘方舟船上究竟发生了什么。
descriptions.en: The Hyacinth has been located above [hyacinth_planet.GetName] and appears to be structurally intact. We will have to assemble a boarding party to learn what has happened to the arkship.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower][pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]之中发现了一位才华横溢的科学家。[abducted_scientist.GetHisHerCap]卓越的才能被浪费在[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的[GetPreFTLLower]文明中，但[abducted_scientist.GetHeShe]对我们自己的研究项目将有巨大的促进作用。绑架[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]并“说服”[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]为我们工作的计划已经提上日程。
descriptions.en: A brilliant scientist has been identified among the [GetPreFTLLower] [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. [abducted_scientist.GetHisHerCap] considerable skill is wasted on [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] [GetPreFTLLower] civilization, but [abducted_scientist.GetHeShe] would be quite a boon to our own research programs. Plans have been put into motion to abduct [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] and then "convince" [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] to work for us instead.

descriptions.zh: 我们给[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的数名[GetPreFTLLowerPlural][pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]测试对象安装大脑植入体之后，遇到了一些问题。他们产生了一系列功能失常的问题，引发了测试者的暴力行为，甚至导致了受试者的死亡。我们需要在产生更多的问题前拆除这些植入体。
descriptions.en: We are having problems with the brain implants that were given to several test subjects among the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. There have been a number of malfunctions, resulting in violent behavior and, in some cases, fatalities. We need to remove these implants before they can cause any more problems.

descriptions.zh: 来自[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]民族国家已经联合在一起并组建了反抗外星人的军事力量，其使命便是阻扰我们在这个星球的行动。这是不能容忍的。我们必须对其主基地进行一次惩罚性的打击。
descriptions.en: The [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] nation states on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have banded together and formed an anti-alien task force with the mission to thwart our operations on their homeworld. This cannot be tolerated. We must launch a punitive strike against the main base of this organization.

descriptions.zh: 合成人潜入者对[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的渗透正在[Root.GetName]内进行。我们需要拿出一个有效而可靠的方法来识别他们。
descriptions.en: Synthetic infiltrators disguised as [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are operating within the [Root.GetName]. We need to come up with some kind of reliable and efficient method of identifying them.

descriptions.zh: [queen_system.GetName]星系最近发生了一场太空战，一只索林原虫虫后重伤濒死，但其仍有生命体征。捕获它将是情报界的一场重大胜利。
descriptions.en: After a recent space battle in the [queen_system.GetName] system, a Prethoryn Queen was badly injured and left for dead by the rest of the Scourge. The creature is still alive, however. Capturing it would be a major intelligence coup.

descriptions.zh:
主力舰队已按计划开入靠近[exercise_neighbor.GetName]边界的[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系。这次演习主要是模拟[exercise_neighbor.GetSpeciesName]军队在入侵之前向我方边界内发射探测器。

一旦所有参演部队到达[exercise_location.GetName]轨道的预定位置，演习就会开始。
descriptions.en:
Major fleet maneuvers have been planned in the [exercise_system.GetName] system, close to the border of the [exercise_neighbor.GetName]. The purpose of this exercise is to simulate a hostile probe by significant [exercise_neighbor.GetSpeciesName] forces into our space, as a possible prelude to an invasion.

The exercise will begin once all of the allocated forces have reached the initial staging area in orbit of [exercise_location.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
主力舰队已按计划开入靠近[exercise_neighbor.GetName]边界的[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系。这次演习主要是模拟[exercise_neighbor.GetSpeciesName]军队在入侵之前向我方边界内发射探测器。

一旦所有参演部队到达[exercise_location.GetName]轨道的预定位置，演习就会开始。

The exercise will begin once all of the allocated forces have reached the initial staging area in orbit of [exercise_location.GetName].

主力舰队已按计划开入靠近[exercise_neighbor.GetName]边界的[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系。这次演习主要是模拟[exercise_neighbor.GetSpeciesName]军队在入侵之前向我方边界内发射探测器。

一旦所有参演部队到达[exercise_location.GetName]轨道的预定位置，演习就会开始。

Major fleet maneuvers have been planned in the [exercise_system.GetName] system, close to the border of the [exercise_neighbor.GetName]. The purpose of this exercise is to simulate a hostile probe by significant [exercise_neighbor.GetSpeciesName] forces into our space, as a possible prelude to an invasion.

The exercise will begin once all of the allocated forces have reached the initial staging area in orbit of [exercise_location.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 我们必须在万事皆休之前设法屏蔽幽灵信号入侵我们的中控核心！
descriptions.en: We must find a way to block the Ghost Signal and prevent it from corrupting our main core before it's too late.

descriptions.zh: 我们得知，在十分遥远的过去，可能有先驱者曾在§H[precursor_planet.GetName]§!上活动。据了解，古老的沃陶姆恒星众的影响范围已经触及到我们所在的这个区域，使得在这个世界的我们能够在探索他们的文明的道路上领先一大步。
descriptions.en: We have learned that there may have been Precursor activity on §H[precursor_planet.GetName]§! at some point in the galactic past. The sphere of influence of the ancient Vultaum Star Assembly is known to have extended to this region of space, making this world a promising lead in our ongoing efforts to learn more about their civilization.

descriptions.zh: 我们得知，在十分遥远的过去，可能有先驱者曾在§H[precursor_planet.GetName]§!上活动。据了解，古老尤特帝国的影响范围已经触及到我们所在的这个区域，使得在这个世界的我们能够在探索他们的文明的道路上领先一大步。
descriptions.en: We have learned that there may have been Precursor activity on §H[precursor_planet.GetName]§! at some point in the galactic past. The sphere of influence of the ancient Yuht Empire is known to have extended to this region of space, making this world a promising lead in our ongoing efforts to learn more about their civilization.

descriptions.zh: 我们得知，在十分遥远的过去，可能有先驱者曾在§H[precursor_planet.GetName]§!上活动。据了解，古老的第一联盟的影响范围已经触及到我们所在的这个区域，使得在这个世界的我们能够在探索他们的文明的道路上领先一大步。
